title: Unable to login
description: Customer cannot log in to their account using the correct email and password.

title: Payment failed
description: The payment fails when the customer tries to complete the checkout process.

title: Order not received
description: Customer has not received the order even though the tracking shows it as delivered.

title: Wrong product delivered
description: Customer received a different product from the one they ordered.

title: Account verification issue
description: Customer is not receiving the verification email after creating an account.

title: Refund request
description: Customer wants a refund for a recently cancelled order.

title: Website loading slowly
description: Customer reports that product pages are taking too long to load.

title: Unable to update profile
description: Customer cannot save changes after updating their profile information.

title: Coupon code not working
description: The promotional coupon code is not being applied during checkout.

title: Product out of stock
description: Customer wants to purchase a product that is currently showing as unavailable.

title: Delivery address change
description: Customer wants to change the delivery address for an existing order.

title: Duplicate order created
description: Customer accidentally placed the same order twice and wants to cancel one.

title: Password reset problem
description: Customer is unable to reset their password using the reset link.

title: Missing item from order
description: One item is missing from the customer's delivered package.

title: Cancel order request
description: Customer wants to cancel an order that has not been shipped yet.
